name: retail-pulse-major-project
description: Multi-Source E-Commerce Intelligence Suite (Retail Pulse, ShopPulse, TechMart & Connector)

scripts.dev:all: npx -y concurrently --kill-others -n "ml,connector,shoppulse,techmart,retailpulse" -c "yellow,magenta,blue,cyan,green" "npm run dev:ml" "npm --prefix retail-pulse-connector run dev" "npm --prefix Site1 run dev" "npm --prefix TechMart run dev" "npm --prefix RetailPulse run dev"
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix retail-pulse-connector run build && node build-vercel.js
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:python
